observations: Footing mismatch: Tedds strip footing uses No.5 bars at 8.0 in c/c bottom (Asy.bot.prov 0.465 in2), f'c 3000 psi, qallow_Gross 3.5 ksf; drawings S-6 specify 24"W x 18"D with (2) #4 T&B, soil bearing assumed 1500 PSF and lap-splice schedule f'c 2500 psi. Calc qmax = 2.49 ksf exceeds the 1.5 ksf drawing value.
Footing loads (FDz1 1.5, FLz1 2.5, FLrz1 0.9, FSz1 0.8, FRz1 0.3 kips per ft) are not traceable to the wall/roof calcs (roof w = 35 psf); snow/rain loads included for Spring Valley.

Shear wall loads look like placeholders: all five walls D = 25 lb/ft, Lf = 20 lb/ft, Lr = 10 lb/ft, W = 18 lbs, Eq = 40 lbs (D/C ≤ 0.006). No seismic or wind base-shear calc exists for the building; CMU uses Eadd = 40 psf and W = 18 psf.
Sheathing mismatch: Tedds uses 7/16'' OSB (8d @ 4'') + 1/2'' gypsum; drawings call 1/2-inch plywood structural sheathing with stucco exterior; roof detail edge nailing 10d @ 6" vs hand calc 8d @ 6".
W5 is titled "2X6 WALL (W5)" but designed with 2x4 studs/end posts; drawings require 2x6 exterior walls.

Wall lengths: W1 calc b = 22.104 ft (22' 1.249") vs elevation 21'-6"; W4 calc b = 39.333 ft has no matching elevation dimension; W6 elevation exists with no calc; W2 17.25 ft and W3 29.667 ft and CMU 35.333 ft match.
W3 and W4: segment 3 (b3 = 1.333 ft / 3.167 ft) not considered — aspect ratio exceeds 1.5 max; capacity uses only b1 + b2.
Roof joist hand calc: 2×10 @ 16" o.c. vs drawings 2×10 @ 24" o.c.; S = 13.14 in³ and I = 47.6 in⁴ are 2×8 properties; species SPF No.2 not stated on drawings.

Editions: CMU per MSJC-13 with ASCE 7-10 combinations; walls NDS2018 + ASCE 7-16; footing ACI318-14 + ASCE 7-16; hand calc cites CBC 2022 / SDPWS 2021; drawing code block not legible. Holdown hardware and anchor checks are absent from calcs (drawings: HDU at each shear wall end, 1/2" anchor bolts @ 6'-0").
CMU wall: No.5 bars at 32 in vertical, f'm 2000 psi, governing combination no.10 utilisation 0.309; no CMU reinforcement/footing shown on the drawing text.
